features.name: Project Setup & Tooling
features.description: Vite 8 + Bun + TypeScript 7 + React 19. ESLint, oxlint, Prettier, Husky pre-commit hooks, TanStack devtools.

features.name: Routing & Navigation
features.description: File-based TanStack Router with auto-generated route tree. Routes: /notes, /chat, /settings, /profile, /tags, /archived, /login, /register.

features.name: Auth System
features.description: better-auth with email/password login, register, OAuth (GitHub, Google). Zod validation via react-hook-form. Session management.

features.name: Notes CRUD & Editor
features.description: Full note management with Lexical rich text editor, markdown support, auto-save, AI title generation, export to markdown, pin/archive/delete.

features.name: Tags Management
features.description: Tag CRUD with color badges, note counts, filter sidebar integration.

features.name: AI Chat / Copilot
features.description: Real AI chat wired to the AI service via Kong (/api/v1/ai). AI SDK v7 useChat + DefaultChatTransport (custom SynapseChatTransport reads X-Conversation-Id, sends Bearer token + last user message), streaming responses, conversation history rail (left of the /chat workspace), suggestions, sources & reasoning display. Model selector, web search toggle, speech input kept as UI; attachments blocked (server text-only).
